open_issues.impact: No contract for project add / project remove yet; the goal text is only partly met.
open_issues.next: P2.2: when adding `project add|remove` (and any create/bind command), add `project-add.schema.json` / `project-remove.schema.json` (and others) to schemas/command/v1 ($id urn:swissknifeman:workspace:command:<kind>:v1, reuse common $defs code/abs_path/binding), extend KINDS in tests/test_command_contracts.py, validate their real --json output there, and list them in the README Typed outputs table. If `project remove` was meant to be today's `detach`, say so and a `project-detach` document is a small addition.
open_issues.text: The goal names `project add|remove`, but the workspace CLI has no such commands (only attach|list|show|scan|rebind|detach); they belong to P2.2. Contracts were written only for commands that exist so tests validate real output; no shape was invented for add/remove.

open_issues.impact: Consumers of --json (P2.3 GUI forms, bridges) can read errors as a typed document: {"error":{"code","message"}}; success documents carry no `error` key, so the key tells them apart.
open_issues.next: P2.2/P2.3: use `error.code` for form messages; new commands raising WorkspaceError get the document automatically through cli._fail.
open_issues.text: Behaviour change: with --json a refused command now also prints the error document on stdout (before: nothing on stdout). Exit codes and the stderr `CODE: message` line are unchanged; without --json nothing changes. Commands that already print a report on failure (sync, doctor --publish-safety, migrate plan) are not affected.

open_issues.impact: Decides how P2.3 validates command output.
open_issues.next: P2.3 decides: go through bridges/workspace CLI output without schema import, or move the set to aicore.
open_issues.text: The contracts live in the workspace module (schemas/command/v1, set loaded with aicore.util.schema.load_contract_set), not in packages/aicore/schemas. A module may not import another; the gui module can only reach them through a bridge or a copy. If the GUI needs them as foundation contracts, they must move to aicore/schemas as per-kind contracts (with examples, unit.json entries and README table rows required by aicore/tests/test_contracts.py).

open_issues.next: Later piece if D4 'everything typed' is to cover them.
open_issues.text: Commands without a contract yet: status, doctor (check-result/v1 per item), sync, clone, project show|scan|rebind|detach, migrate *. Stated in the README.

focus: lib/workspace/cli.py _fail/_error_document: --json refusals now print an error document on stdout
schemas/command/v1/*.schema.json against the real output shapes (layout.init/list_rows, remote.connect, projects.list_projects/attach)

summary: Added the workspace-owned contract set schemas/command/v1 (urn:swissknifeman:workspace:command): closed schemas for the --json output of init, list, connect, project list, project attach and for the error document, plus shared common definitions; registered in unit.json. cli.py now also prints {"error":{"code","message"}} on stdout for a refusal (exit 1) or an invalid argument value (exit 2, INVALID_ARGUMENT) when --json is given; stderr line and exit codes are unchanged. New tests/test_command_contracts.py validates the real CLI output of each command against the schemas, checks the error cases, closedness/descriptions, unit.json registration and rejection of broken documents. README (Typed outputs section) and CHANGELOG updated. Module tests: bash packages/workspace/scripts/test.sh, 301 tests OK.
